publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
label: 聽力 5

ex.en: Woman: Excuse me, I have a concern about this coat I received as a birthday gift. It appears to be missing a few buttons. Is it possible to exchange it for another one?
ex.zh: 女：不好意思，我收到這件當生日禮物的外套，有點問題。它好像少了幾顆鈕扣，可以換一件嗎？

tips.t: exchange A for B 用 A 換 B；exchanges and refunds 換貨與退款。

ex.en: Man: Certainly, that shouldn't be an issue, but we can only exchange it if it was bought within the last fourteen days. Do you have the receipt so I can verify the purchase date?
ex.zh: 男：當然，這應該沒問題，但只有在過去十四天內購買的才能換。您有收據讓我確認購買日期嗎？

tips.t: original receipt 原始收據（p 不發音）。

ex.en: Woman: Well, the catering company we used at our last party did a wonderful job with the selection of food they served. Why don't we use them again and let them handle the entire thing?
ex.zh: 女：嗯，上次派對找的外燴公司，菜色選得很棒。何不再找他們，整個交給他們處理？

tips.t: catering service 外燴服務（活動籌備題必考）。

ex.en: Man: That sounds like a good idea, and it will save us a lot of work. Can you call them and make the necessary arrangements, then?
ex.zh: 男：聽起來是好主意，還能省下很多工夫。那你可以打給他們，把需要的事情安排好嗎？

tips.t: make arrangements for 為～做安排。

ex.en: Woman: Okay, what kind of features are you looking for in particular?
ex.zh: 女：好的，您特別想要什麼功能？

tips.t: new features 新功能；The event will feature ～ 活動將有～。

ex.en: Man: Hey, remember that the auditors from the headquarters are scheduled to arrive tomorrow morning to begin their review of our operations. Let's spend the whole day getting those files organized so that the auditors can finish faster.
ex.zh: 男：嘿，別忘了總公司的稽核人員明天早上就要來審查我們的營運。我們花一整天把檔案整理好，讓他們可以早點完成。

ex.en: Hotel staff: Welcome to the Radisson Hotel. I'm the event coordinator, and this is my colleague, Diane. Are you interested in holding an event here?
ex.zh: 飯店人員：歡迎光臨 Radisson 飯店。我是活動統籌，這位是我的同事 Diane。您有興趣在這裡辦活動嗎？

ex.en: Man: Okay. What's more, around half of our guests will be arriving from out of town. Is there enough accommodation available for them to stay here?
ex.zh: 男：好的。另外，大約一半的賓客是從外地來的。這裡有足夠的房間讓他們住嗎？

ex.en: Woman: I'm confident that we have enough rooms available, but we'll check and send you a quote for a group rate. And also, we offer complimentary shuttle service to and from the airport.
ex.zh: 女：我相信我們的房間夠，不過我們會確認一下，再把團體價的報價寄給您。另外，我們也提供免費的機場接送服務。

tips.t: complimentary breakfast 免費早餐（≠ complementary 互補的）。

ex.en: Man: Yes, I'm representing the National Journalist Association. We're planning our annual awards banquet for June, with around 100 guests.
ex.zh: 男：是的，我代表全國記者協會。我們正在規劃六月的年度頒獎晚宴，大約一百位賓客。

tips.t: awards banquet 頒獎晚宴；banquet hall 宴會廳。

convo.en: Certainly, that shouldn't be an issue, but we can only exchange it if it was bought within the last fourteen days. Do you have the receipt so I can verify the purchase date?
convo.zh: 當然，這應該沒問題，但只有在過去十四天內購買的才能換。您有收據讓我確認購買日期嗎？

convo.en: I'm sorry, I wasn't given the receipt since it was a gift from my friend. However, he gave it to me just last Wednesday, so I believe he bought it recently.
convo.zh: 抱歉，這是朋友送的，所以我沒拿到收據。不過他上週三才給我，所以我想他應該是最近買的。

convo.en: I apologize, but according to our store policy, we require the original receipt for all exchanges and refunds.
convo.zh: 很抱歉，依照本店規定，所有換貨和退款都需要原始收據。

opts: To take part in an audition

convo.en: Hey, remember that the auditors from the headquarters are scheduled to arrive tomorrow morning to begin their review of our operations. Let's spend the whole day getting those files organized so that the auditors can finish faster.
convo.zh: 嘿，別忘了總公司的稽核人員明天早上就要來審查我們的營運。我們花一整天把檔案整理好，讓他們可以早點完成。

convo.en: I know, but I have an important meeting this morning. Can you start on your own? I can join you around 2 P.M. to help wrap things up.
convo.zh: 我知道，但我今天早上有個重要的會。你可以先自己開始嗎？我大概兩點可以加入，幫忙收尾。

convo.en: There's a lot of work to be done before the auditors arrive. Can you try to finish by noon? Otherwise, I think we'll have to stay late tonight.
convo.zh: 稽核人員來之前有很多事要做。你能不能試著中午前結束？不然我想我們今晚得加班了。

convo.en: These meetings tend to run long, but I'll do my best to finish as quickly as possible.
convo.zh: 這種會議常常會拖很久，但我會盡量早點結束。

convo.en: Welcome to the Radisson Hotel. I'm the event coordinator, and this is my colleague, Diane. Are you interested in holding an event here?
convo.zh: 歡迎光臨 Radisson 飯店。我是活動統籌，這位是我的同事 Diane。您有興趣在這裡辦活動嗎？

convo.en: Yes, I'm representing the National Journalist Association. We're planning our annual awards banquet for June, with around 100 guests.
convo.zh: 是的，我代表全國記者協會。我們正在規劃六月的年度頒獎晚宴，大約一百位賓客。

convo.en: Excellent. We have a stunning ballroom on this level that has been used for awards ceremonies previously.
convo.zh: 太好了。我們這一層有一間很漂亮的宴會廳，以前辦過頒獎典禮。

convo.en: Okay. What's more, around half of our guests will be arriving from out of town. Is there enough accommodation available for them to stay here?
convo.zh: 好的。另外，大約一半的賓客是從外地來的。這裡有足夠的房間讓他們住嗎？

convo.en: I'm confident that we have enough rooms available, but we'll check and send you a quote for a group rate. And also, we offer complimentary shuttle service to and from the airport.
convo.zh: 我相信我們的房間夠，不過我們會確認一下，再把團體價的報價寄給您。另外，我們也提供免費的機場接送服務。
